alias: FLIGHT BOARD — обслуживание запроса часов (MQTT) v3.4
description: req -> синхронный фетч ОБОИХ сенсоров (past departures/arrivals + future scheduled_*) -> ждём last_updated обоих -> merge+dedup(fa_flight_id) -> окно ±2ч -> сортировка -> now_idx в середине -> РОВНО ОДНА publish RETAINED. Единый троттл 90с на пару (republish без фетча). Убраны раздельные past/scheduled троттлы -> нет флапа n=15↔n=29 и двойной публикации. Бюджет: 2 rs/направление (past+scheduled, max_pages=1) = $0.01. Payload-контракт неизменен.

variables.apt_label: {% set m = {"LFMD": "LFMD — Канны", "LFMN": "LFMN — Ницца", "LFPG": "LFPG — Париж CDG", "EGLL": "EGLL — Лондон LHR", "EDDF": "EDDF — Франкфурт", "EHAM": "EHAM — Амстердам"} %}{{ m[trigger.payload_json.apt] }}
variables.age_s: {% set m = states('input_text.flightboard_last_fetch_map') %}{% set d = (m | from_json) if m not in ['unknown','unavailable',''] else {} %}{% set k = trigger.payload_json.apt ~ '_' ~ trigger.payload_json.dir %}{% set last = d.get(k, 0) | int(0) %}{{ (now().timestamp() | int) - last }}

data.message: flightboard THROTTLED age={{ age_s }}s key={{ trigger.payload_json.apt }}_{{ dir }} republish-no-fetch

data.payload: {% set apt = trigger.payload_json.apt %}{% set dir = trigger.payload_json.dir %}{% if dir == 'arr' %}{% set past = state_attr('sensor.aeroapi_arrivals_board','arrivals') or [] %}{% set fut = state_attr('sensor.aeroapi_scheduled_arrivals_board','scheduled_arrivals') or [] %}{% else %}{% set past = state_attr('sensor.aeroapi_departures_board','departures') or [] %}{% set fut = state_attr('sensor.aeroapi_scheduled_departures_board','scheduled_departures') or [] %}{% endif %}{% set now_ts = now().timestamp() %}{% set lo = now_ts - 7200 %}{% set hi = now_ts + 7200 %}{% set seen = namespace(ids=[]) %}{% set paired = namespace(list=[]) %}{% for f in (past + fut) %}{% set fid = f.fa_flight_id if f.fa_flight_id else (f.ident ~ '|' ~ (f.scheduled_out | default(f.scheduled_in) | default(''))) %}{% if fid not in seen.ids %}{% if dir == 'arr' %}{% set araw = f.actual_in if f.actual_in else (f.estimated_in if f.estimated_in else f.scheduled_in) %}{% else %}{% set araw = f.actual_out if f.actual_out else (f.estimated_out if f.estimated_out else f.scheduled_out) %}{% endif %}{% if araw %}{% set ats = as_timestamp(as_datetime(araw)) %}{% if ats >= lo and ats <= hi and (f.ident_iata or f.ident_icao or f.ident) %}{% set seen.ids = seen.ids + [fid] %}{% set paired.list = paired.list + [{'f': f, 'a': ats}] %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% set paired.list = paired.list | sort(attribute='a') %}{% set nidx = namespace(v=paired.list|length) %}{% for p in paired.list %}{% if p.a >= now_ts and nidx.v == (paired.list|length) %}{% set nidx.v = loop.index0 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% set ns = namespace(items=[]) %}{% for p in paired.list %}{% set f = p.f %}{% set fn = (f.ident_iata or f.ident_icao or f.ident) %}{% set tm = (as_datetime(p.a) | as_local).strftime('%H:%M') %}{% if f.cancelled %}{% set st = 'canc' %}{% elif f.actual_in %}{% set st = 'land' %}{% elif f.actual_off %}{% set st = 'dep' %}{% elif f.actual_out %}{% set st = 'board' %}{% elif (f.scheduled_out and f.estimated_out and (as_datetime(f.estimated_out) - as_datetime(f.scheduled_out)).total_seconds() > 900) or (f.scheduled_in and f.estimated_in and (as_datetime(f.estimated_in) - as_datetime(f.scheduled_in)).total_seconds() > 900) %}{% set st = 'delay' %}{% else %}{% set st = 'sched' %}{% endif %}{% if dir == 'arr' %}{% set ct = f.origin.code_iata | default(f.origin.code_icao) | default('') %}{% else %}{% set ct = f.destination.code_iata | default(f.destination.code_icao) | default('') %}{% endif %}{% set ns.items = ns.items + [{'fn': fn, 'tm': tm, 'st': st, 'ct': ct}] %}{% endfor %}{% set half = 7 %}{% set win = 15 %}{% set start = [nidx.v - half, 0] | max %}{% set capped = ns.items[start:start + win] %}{% set out = {'apt': apt, 'dir': dir, 'n': capped|length, 'upd': now().strftime('%H:%M'), 'now_idx': [nidx.v - start, capped|length] | min, 'f': capped} %}{{ out | to_json }}

variables.prev_lu_sched: {{ states[sensor_sched_id].last_updated if states[sensor_sched_id] is not none else '' }}

default.wait_template: {{ states[sensor_id].last_updated != prev_lu and (states[sensor_sched_id] is none or states[sensor_sched_id].last_updated != prev_lu_sched) }}

data.message: flightboard FETCH(both) key={{ trigger.payload_json.apt }}_{{ dir }} publish-once

data.value: {% set m = states('input_text.flightboard_last_fetch_map') %}{% set d = (m | from_json) if m not in ['unknown','unavailable',''] else {} %}{% set k = trigger.payload_json.apt ~ '_' ~ trigger.payload_json.dir %}{% set d = dict(d, **{k: (now().timestamp() | int)}) %}{{ d | to_json }}
